title: GDCGenomicsQC: Genomic Quality Control Pipeline
description: A Snakemake-based pipeline for comprehensive genomic quality control, including relatedness estimation, global/local ancestry classification, SNP heritability estimation (AdjHE, PredLMM-ACE, fastGWA), and polygenic risk scoring across multiple ancestries. Designed for HPC environments with SLURM scheduling and containerized execution via Apptainer/Singularity.
